# ggsuppress

The goal of [ggsuppress](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/) is to
provide a seamless way to apply small-number suppression to public
health data visualizations in ggplot2. Values below a specified
threshold (default \< 11) are automatically plotted at a proxy value and
given distinct symbology.

## Installation

You can install the development version of ggsuppress like so:

``` r

# Depending on your hosting solution, instructions will go here.
# Example for GitHub:
# devtools::install_github("peernisse/ggsuppress")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(ggsuppress)
library(ggplot2)

# Using the built-in overdoses dataset
ggplot(overdoses, aes(x = month_date, y = count, color = county)) +
  geom_line_suppressed(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_suppressed(size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salt Lake" = "navy", "Utah" = "darkorange")) +
  scale_shape_suppress() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Overdoses by County", x = "Date", y = "Count")
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-1.png)

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r

summary(cars)
#>      speed           dist       
#>  Min.   : 4.0   Min.   :  2.00  
#>  1st Qu.:12.0   1st Qu.: 26.00  
#>  Median :15.0   Median : 36.00  
#>  Mean   :15.4   Mean   : 42.98  
#>  3rd Qu.:19.0   3rd Qu.: 56.00  
#>  Max.   :25.0   Max.   :120.00
```

You’ll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md`
up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

![](reference/figures/README-pressure-1.png)

In that case, don’t forget to commit and push the resulting figure
files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`geom_point_suppressed()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/geom_suppress.md)
  [`geom_col_suppressed()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/geom_suppress.md)
  [`geom_line_suppressed()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/geom_suppress.md)
  : Geometries for Small-Number Suppression
- [`groundwater`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/groundwater.md)
  : Mock Groundwater Monitoring Dataset
- [`overdoses`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/overdoses.md)
  : Monthly Overdoses in Utah and Salt Lake Counties
- [`scale_shape_suppress()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/scale_suppress.md)
  [`scale_alpha_suppress()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/scale_suppress.md)
  [`scale_color_suppress()`](https://peernisse.github.io/ggsuppress/reference/scale_suppress.md)
  : Custom scales for small-number suppression
